newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal extradites Italian mafia boss.
newsitem.headline: Portugal extradites Italian mafia boss.

text.p: Portugal extradited a mafia leader, Emilio di Giovinni , to Italy on Friday to continue serving a 22-year sentence for murder, officials said.
"On the authorisation of a court following a request from Interpol, Giovinni was extradited to Italy," Celso Manata, director general of prison services, told reporters.

Giovinni, who escaped from Italy in 1990, was arrested in a drugs rai in the Algarve region of southern Portugal in July 1992 and was sentenced last year to 14 years in jail on drug and other charges.
Portuguese media said he had been on hunger strike to protest aagainst his proposed extradition.
Officials said Giovinni was flown to an undisclosed destination in Italy. He was also wanted in Spain in connection with three murders there.

His lawyer, Luisa Gomes da Silva, said she was angry and surprised at the extradition. "The extradition of Giovinni to Italy was precipitous. The proper time frame for this matter was not respected," she said.
